main_text.p: 2. De iisdem Basilicis alterum brevius opusculum centum fere paginarum, aliqua continens, quae in priori desiderantur, puta de oblatione olim in Basilicis fieri solita.
3. De Graecorum Ecclesiis ad Leonem Allatium Epistola prolixa cum earumdem delineatione.
4. Altera de materia eadem Epistola, quam secutum est Allatii responsum, in Lu-cem nuper editum à R.P. Richardo Simo-ne nostrae Congregationis Presbytero.
5. De Paschate, seu de vetustissimis [?] Christianorum Paschalis exercitatio Ec-clesiastica, quam olim à se edendam promiserat Morinus ipse in Praefatione Exertita-tionum Ecclesiasticarum.
6. De Sacramento Confirmationis dissertatio, in qua praesertim celebres de ejus materia & Ministro quaestiones ventilantur.
7. De Disciplina à Patribus observata in expiatione Catechumenorum, & eorum ad Baptismi susceptionem praeparatione, tractatus ducentarum fere paginarum.
8. Christiani Lupi Augustiniani, Epi-stola ad Joannem Morinum de aliquot

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "vetustissimis" in item 5 is marked [?] because the word is blurred. "Paschate" in item 5 could also be read as "Pascha te" at the scan resolution; I have read it as "Paschate". Long s is written as plain s throughout. The ampersands are kept as printed. The numbers 2 to 8 are the printed list numbers and are kept as plain text.
